capabilities: SI species validation with argon reference data and provenance
periodic box with minimum image, wrapping, squared distances
LJ pair kernel from r2 with truncated-cutoff policy
velocity-Verlet pair step with re-evaluated forces
end-to-end static dimer, dimer dynamics, static chain

dynamics.horizon: 256 velocity-Verlet steps in 8 nested blocks of 32
dynamics.integrator: velocity-Verlet with single LJ evaluation per step
dynamics.reference_run: dt=0.002 from rest at r=1.3, drift 4.2e-5, period ~0.77

formulation.cutoff: truncated (not shifted) at rc, beyond-cutoff pairs neglected as legitimate physics
formulation.potential: U(r) = 4 eps ((sig/r)^12 - (sig/r)^6), F from r2 without sqrt
formulation.units: SI species; canonical verification in reduced units

history: bootstrap: architecture docs only, no implementation
foundation: first canonical native implementation (this revision)
implementation: first and only canonical implementation; no version forks, no native/host split, no compatibility layers
meaning: classical atomic-scale particle simulation; explicitly not CPU atomics and not quantum chemistry
native_coverage: species, state, pair kernel, integrator, drivers, derived quantities, and verification are MNCS-native; only float operators and rounding/discipline are consumed from language/numerics
numeric_discipline: exact == on dyadic/rationals; approx with stated tolerances (1e-15 SI, 1e-12 statics, 1e-9 dynamics, 1e-4 drift bound); every division guarded; non-finite inputs fail fast by the language trap rule
solver_boundary: no solver: explicit VV has no algebraic solve; stability evidence is the measured drift bound
